title: Rama to the Rescue
subject: English
summary: “Rama to the Rescue” is an interesting story about a clever man named Rama. One night, a thief entered a house to steal money and valuables. The family members were frightened and did not know what to do. Rama stayed calm and used his intelligence to save the situation. He cleverly tricked the thief and helped the family get rid of him. In the end, the thief was caught, and everyone was safe. The story teaches us that we should stay calm and use our intelligence during difficult situations.
